device.processor: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

staticCallChain: Platform.dll exports SetPPTLimit and imports Device.dll!GetDeviceManager
Device.dll contains the AMDRyzenMasterDriverV31 device name and driver lifecycle helpers

findings: The identified Synapse CPU backend is not a self-contained user-mode protocol. It reaches a demand-start AMD kernel driver through signed AMD helper libraries.
The server-to-Platform-to-Device import chain and the driver device name establish the ownership boundary without loading a library, opening the driver, or issuing an IOCTL.

Static strings and call sites expose candidate CPU-family methods and IOCTL values, but do not prove the selected runtime class, structures, signatures, units, authorization, safety, or readback semantics.
Using the installed Razer/AMD components would make OpenBlade depend on Synapse-delivered binaries and a kernel driver, which violates the product architecture.
No production backend can be admitted from this evidence. CPU Power Limit and CPU Voltage Optimizer remain first-class ObservedOnly capabilities.
